cohort: 7206 children born in Alberta, Canada between 2010-2012 diagnosed with asthma before age 5
finding: Maternal perinatal factors including prenatal antibiotic use, gestational diabetes, prenatal smoking, C-section delivery, and summertime birth, as well as early-life hospitalizations for respiratory illness were associated with partly or uncontrolled childhood asthma.
mod_finding: Children born via C-section were at increased risk of both partly controlled (aRR: 1.11; 95% CI 1.00 to 1.25) and uncontrolled asthma (aRR: 1.18; 95% CI 1.00 to 1.39).
